label: EltonTraits 1.0: species-level foraging attributes of the world's birds and mammals (BirdFuncDat.txt, MamFuncDat.txt)
bibliographic_citation: Wilman H, Belmaker J, Simpson J, de la Rosa C, Rivadeneira MM, Jetz W (2014) EltonTraits 1.0: Species-level foraging attributes of the world's birds and mammals. Ecology 95:2027.
license: CC BY 4.0 (figshare deposit of the Ecological Archives data paper E095-178)
measurement_technique: Literature-compiled diet composition, foraging stratum, activity period and body mass for 9,993 bird and 5,400 mammal species.
role: diet, foraging stratum and body mass for the listed bird and mammal taxa (rows matched on Scientific name or family)
